about: master-output: port of the static LDR patch `master_final_v2` to a single open-field pack, with a custom master.svg carried as a picture. Fourteen places of the firmware (Master-page encoder remap + Shift-link, L/R post-makeup) plus the matching display. Note: the ???12 dBFS threshold change of master_final_v2 has been dropped since v2, the four drive stages now keep their stock ???6 dBFS threshold.
